capabilities: Insert stopwatch and countdown badges on note lines
Toggle, pause, resume, stop, reset, and delete timers via hotkeys or a badge context menu
Edit a timer's elapsed or target time via command or menu
Track daily and weekly totals, streaks, per-file time, and session history in an analytics panel
Play a sound and show a notification when a countdown reaches zero
extras: Timer state is stored as inline text tags in the Markdown itself (no external state files), so timers persist in the note text and expire in the background even on Canvas or closed notes. Beta versions are installable via BRAT. The README documents CodeMirror 6 rendering internals and Bun build steps.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track how much time you spend on a note or task without leaving the app for a separate timer tool.

relations.evidence: You can install beta versions of Tag Timer using the BRAT plugin

summary: Inline time-tracking plugin that inserts stopwatch and countdown badges into notes and reports time analytics in a sidebar panel.
